claude.sample_unit: expert evaluations of LLM-generated incident report summaries and taxonomy tags

links.outcome: LLM performance differences across two institutions' incident reports
links.effect: Institution 1 summary scores 3.34→4.20 (d=0.78) vs institution 2 3.61→4.02 (d=0.34, P=.055); Round 2 summaries ≥4: 80.0% vs 68.9%.
links.quote: Performance improvements establish technical feasibility for further development, while institutional variation suggests that site-specific factors may influence system effectiveness, which warrants further investigation.
